concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
question: A tank is (3)/(5) full of water. If 20 liters of water is added, it becomes (7)/(10) full. What is the full capacity of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial filled part of tank = (3)/(5) 

Final filled part of tank = (7)/(10) 

Water added = 20

**Formula Used:**

Added water = Total capacity × (Final fraction − Initial fraction)
